descriptor: Caltrac AI ([caltrac.ai](https://caltrac.ai)), the AI calorie and macro tracker.

keyFacts.label: Review
keyFacts.value: A person at Caltrac reviews every application within 24–48 hours.

keyFacts.label: How clients log
keyFacts.value: A photo or a short description. Calories and macros are estimates that clients can edit.

keyFacts.label: How clients share
keyFacts.value: Clients enter your code in Caltrac Connect and send a request; access starts when you accept it.

keyFacts.label: Who controls access
keyFacts.value: The client, who can stop sharing at any time.

keyFacts.label: Apps
keyFacts.value: iPhone (iOS 17 or later) and Android (Android 14 or later).

focus.heading: What it focuses on
focus.body: Caltrac for Professionals focuses on one job: seeing the meals clients choose to share, and commenting on them.

clientControl.heading: Clients stay in control of their meals
clientControl.body: You see a client's meals only after they enter your linking code and grant access. {{accessWording}} You can comment on meals. Clients can stop sharing at any time, without asking anyone, and it takes effect immediately. You can't search for, invite or add a client. Every link starts with them.

steps.text: Apply with your name and email.
A person at Caltrac reviews your application.
If approved, you get your account and linking code.
Your clients enter your code in Caltrac Connect and send a request; access starts when you accept it.

scope.heading: A note on scope
scope.body: Caltrac shows what clients choose to log. It doesn't give medical advice, and calorie and macro figures are estimates. Use your own professional judgment and work within your qualifications.

closingHeading: Ready to see your clients' meals?
closingText: Apply to join. It's free, and a person at Caltrac reads every application.
hipaaClause: Caltrac AI is not a “covered entity” or “business associate” under HIPAA, and the health information you provide is not protected health information subject to HIPAA.
accessWording: Access covers the meals your client logs, their nutrition goals and how their net calories compare with those goals.
